# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is described as a heavy girl, making the role of a fairy queen unsuited for her. She wears dresses with flounces following current fashions, as well as an evening dress during her time studying in Port Marlow.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c34 P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001)_

## Personality

Flossie is known for possessing a caustic, sharp tongue and frequently making malicious or mocking remarks toward her peers. She is bold, bold-faced in asking questions, competitive, and quick to challenge or mock others. Though she lacks a creative imagination, she maintains a proud and haughty demeanor regardless of her performance. Her family background contributes to a reputation for general unpleasantness and dishonesty.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c27 P31](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0031), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## Abilities

- Balancing and walking along wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- Gain an education at college without needing to earn a livelihood  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school under Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Thorne, where she gained a reputation for dishonest behavior such as cheating during spelling lessons. During a garden gathering, she successfully walked the crest of the Pembroke fence and challenged Nell Harcourt to walk the kitchen roof ridgepole, resulting in Nell falling and injuring her ankle. Later, she participated in the school concert preparations, although she became moody after being denied the role of fairy queen due to her weight and lack of slimness. Flossie won the top prize for knitted lace at a local fair, and eventually joined the Regent's Entrance preparation class. She passed the Entrance examination by a narrow three-point margin and moved to Port Marlow to attend Regent's Academy. During her time at the Academy, she resided at the same lodging house as Frank Stockley, earned a reputation for being the most sharp-tongued student at Regent's, and successfully passed her year-end examinations, choosing to return to Regent's for another year rather than taking up teaching.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_

## Background by volume

- Member of the Tulk family  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)</sub>
- Her father is wealthy enough to afford her ongoing education  <sub>[v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)</sub>
- Was the last of a long succession of Tulks to attend Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> I don’t believe it. I don’t believe anyone could walk a ridgepole. At any rate, you couldn’t.  <sub>[v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)</sub>

> In that case, I challenge you to manage it. I challenge you to scale that spot and balance across the ridgepole belonging to the kitchen roof of Mr. Pembroke.  <sub>[v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

> Will you return the following year, Miss Thorne?  <sub>[v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030)</sub>

> You’ve been weeping. I imagine you’re missing home—certain folks possess so little restraint regarding that. I certainly don't plan to be homesick, let me assure you. City life is far too wonderful after that dull old Brierley. I marvel at how I managed to survive there for such a long time. You ought not to weep, Nell; it fails to flatter you, because your nose and eyes turn crimson, making you appear completely flushed. I had an absolutely delightful experience at the Academy today. Our French instructor is a total sweetheart. The sight of his moustache would make your heart flutter. Do you possess any food nearby, Nell? I am genuinely ravenous. Ah, I suspected it was probable Thirza would pack you full of cake. That is the reason I came by. If not for that, I would have proceeded to the park so I could listen to the band perform alongside Frank Stockley. He resides at the same lodging as I do, and he is a fun-loving fellow. > It makes no difference to me. Should I fail to pass during this year, I shall return for the following one. Paying for me to attend is well within my father's means.
